//: Reviewed per-package licence exceptions (ADR-0009 A6/A8, ADR-0010; M1-AC24, M1-AC29). Exact versions only, so a version bump forces a re-review. "license" is the licence as established (or UNKNOWN, which requires "prepublishBlocker": true for the M5 pre-publish gate); "noticeText" is what third-party-notices.txt uses when the package ships no licence file. Used by `corepack yarn check:licenses` and `corepack yarn workspace web-build notices`.

exceptions.name: @joplin/onenote-converter
exceptions.evidence: npm tarball @joplin/onenote-converter@3.7.1: package.json "license": "MPL-2.0-no-copyleft-exception" and the MPL-2.0 text in LICENSE (sha1 7b6950d6fb7defbc9d9e4806e028d5400d363e93); source at gitHead https://github.com/laurent22/joplin/tree/c17c205049ce74e449dc1ce08cbd1c875410d7d5/packages/onenote-converter
exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of joplin@3.7.1 (the pinned CLI), shipped unmodified from npm. MPL-2.0-no-copyleft-exception is a different SPDX ID from the allow-listed MPL-2.0: Exhibit B only stops the MPL files from being relicensed under the GPL family; combining them unmodified in our AGPL-3.0-or-later aggregate, under MPL with their source available (MPL section 3.3), is allowed (docs/backlog/M1.md, M1-AC24, architect's position). Re-review if the package is ever patched.

exceptions.name: node-bitmap
exceptions.evidence: npm tarball node-bitmap@0.0.1: README.md, section "License", states "(The MIT License) Copyright (c) 2012 Yusuke Hata" followed by the MIT permission and warranty text; package.json declares no licence and the tarball has no licence file. Source: https://github.com/nowelium/node-bitmap (README.md, same statement; no tags).
exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of joplin@3.7.1 (the pinned CLI), shipped unmodified from npm. Its package.json has no "license" field, but the licence is established as MIT by the author's statement in the published README, so it is not a pre-publish blocker. noticeText is that README section verbatim.
